source: Tubelli, A.A. et al. "How the Human Cochlea Moves: Biomechanical Modeling of a Wide Layered Osseous Spiral Lamina." -- finite-element human cochlear model validated against temporal-bone motion measurements. Phase at the ~11 kHz BF place decreases from approximately +0.35 cycles at f/BF=0.02 to -0.20 cycles at f/BF=0.9 (long-wavelength, pre-dispersive region), i.e. -0.55 cycles total. Measured data show similar though variable trends.
